name: Homburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Homburg (a green linden tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Homburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Homburg arms — green linden tree on white
